literal: Yang Yin; Yan Zixian; Song Qindao; Zheng Yi
idiomatic: Yang Yin; Yan Zixian; Song Qindao; Zheng Yi

literal: Yang Yin, styled Zunyin, childhood name Prince of Qin, was a man of Huayin in Hongnong.
idiomatic: Yang Yin, styled Zunyin, childhood name Prince of Qin, was from Huayin in Hongnong.

literal: His father Jin in Wei times rose repeatedly to Director of Works and Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: His father Jin had served Wei repeatedly as director of works and palace attendant.

literal: In childhood Yin seemed as though he could not speak, yet was deep and keen in manner; going in and out of gates, he never played about.
idiomatic: As a child Yin seemed barely able to speak, yet was deeply perceptive in manner; in and out of the household gates he never played about.

literal: At six he studied historical works; at eleven he received the Odes and the Changes, and loved the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
idiomatic: At six he studied historical works; at eleven he took up the Odes and the Changes, and loved the Zuo Tradition of the Spring and Autumn Annals.

literal: He lost his mother young and once went to his maternal uncle Yuan Zigong; Zigong drank with him and asked what book he was reading. He said: "I am reciting the Odes.
idiomatic: He lost his mother young and once visited his maternal uncle Yuan Zigong; Zigong drank with him and asked what book he was reading. He said, "I am reciting the Odes.

literal: " Zigong said: "Have you recited as far as 'On the Wei-yang'?
idiomatic: " Zigong said, "Have you recited as far as 'On the Wei-yang'?

literal: " Yin at once wailed and choked with grief; Zigong wept in answer, and thereupon stopped the drinking.
idiomatic: " Yin at once wailed and choked with grief; Zigong wept in answer, and thereupon stopped the drinking.

literal: Later Zigong said to Jin: "I always said Prince of Qin was not very sharp; from now on I shall view him with new eyes.
idiomatic: Later Zigong said to Jin, "I always said Prince of Qin was not very sharp; from now on I shall view him with new eyes.

literal: " One household in Yin's clan lived together four generations; the family was very prosperous, and more than thirty brothers and cousins went to school.
idiomatic: " One household in Yin's clan lived together four generations; the family was very prosperous, and more than thirty brothers and cousins went to school.

literal: Before the school court stood a crabapple tree; when fruit fell to the ground the boys all scrambled for it, while Yin sat apart in calm.
idiomatic: Before the school court stood a crabapple tree; when fruit fell to the ground the boys all scrambled for it, while Yin sat apart in calm.

literal: His uncle Wei happened to enter the school hall, saw it, and greatly marveled; turning to the guests he said: "This boy is tranquil and ample—he has our family's air.
idiomatic: His uncle Wei happened to enter the school hall, saw it, and greatly marveled; turning to the guests he said, "This boy is tranquil and ample—he has our family's air.

literal: " Within the residence were thick bamboos; he therefore built a separate room for Yin at the edge of the grove and ordered him to live there alone, regularly serving him a full meal in a bronze tray.
idiomatic: Within the residence were thick bamboos; he therefore built a separate room for Yin at the edge of the grove and ordered him to live there alone, regularly serving him a full meal in a bronze tray.

literal: He thereby urged and admonished the sons, saying: "You need only be as careful as Zunyin, and you will yourselves win a bamboo grove chamber and bronze-tray feasts of heavy meat.
idiomatic: He thereby urged and admonished the sons, saying, "You need only be as careful as Zunyin, and you will yourselves win a bamboo-grove chamber and bronze-tray feasts of heavy meat."

literal: " Yin's cousin by the father's line, Palace Attendant Yu, especially valued him and once told others: "This boy's colt teeth have not yet fallen, yet already he is our family's dragon pattern.
idiomatic: Yin's cousin by the father's line, palace attendant Yu, especially valued him and once told others, "This boy's colt teeth have not yet fallen, yet already he is our family's dragon pattern.

literal: Ten years hence you will have to seek him a thousand li away.
idiomatic: Ten years hence you will have to seek him a thousand li away."

literal: " Yu once composed a poem with more than ten men; Yin read it once and recited it, missing nothing.
idiomatic: Yu once composed a poem with more than ten men; Yin read it once and recited it, missing nothing.

literal: When grown he could discourse in pure talk, had a fine voice, was spiritually handsome and quick of wit, and his bearing was worth watching.
idiomatic: When grown he could hold pure talk, had a fine voice, was spiritually handsome and quick of wit, and his bearing was worth watching.

literal: Gentlemen who met him all regarded him with respect and wonder; those with insight mostly promised him a far-reaching future.
idiomatic: Gentlemen who met him all regarded him with respect and wonder; those with insight mostly promised him a far-reaching future.

literal: In the Zhenguang era he followed his father to Bing province.
idiomatic: In the Zhenguang era he followed his father to Bing province.

literal: His nature being tranquil and silent and also fond of mountains and rivers, he entered Weng Mountain in Jinyang West county to read books.
idiomatic: His nature being tranquil and silent and also fond of mountains and rivers, he entered Weng Mountain in Jinyang West county to read books.

literal: At the beginning of Xiaochang, Jin became inspector of Dingzhou and Yin also followed his father to his post.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Xiaochang, Jin became inspector of Dingzhou and Yin also followed his father to his post.

literal: For military merit he was made supervisor of the Feathered Forest, enfeoffed as Marquis of Weichang, and did not accept.
idiomatic: For military merit he was made supervisor of the Feathered Forest, enfeoffed as Marquis of Weichang, and did not accept.

literal: When Zhongshan fell to Du Luozhou, the whole family was taken prisoner.
idiomatic: When Zhongshan fell to Du Luozhou, the whole family was taken prisoner.

literal: Before long Luozhou was destroyed and they fell again to Ge Rong.
idiomatic: Before long Luozhou was destroyed and they fell again to Ge Rong.

literal: Rong wished to marry his daughter to him and also pressed a false office on him.
idiomatic: Rong wished to marry his daughter to him and also pressed a false office on him.

literal: Yin then feigned illness, secretly held several he of ox blood in his mouth, spat it out in the crowd, and still pretended to be mute and speechless.
idiomatic: Yin then feigned illness, secretly held several he of ox blood in his mouth, spat it out in the crowd, and still pretended to be mute and speechless.

literal: Rong believed it real and thereupon stopped.
idiomatic: Rong believed it real and thereupon stopped.

literal: At the beginning of Yong'an he returned to Luoyang and was appointed attendant gentleman of the Unimpeded Staff; he was then eighteen.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Yong'an he returned to Luoyang and was appointed attendant gentleman of the unimpeded staff; he was then eighteen.

literal: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Yin at the time had a cousin Kan serving as General of the North Center, garrisoning He Bridge.
idiomatic: When Yuan Hao entered Luoyang, Yin at the time had a cousin Kan serving as general of the north center, garrisoning He Bridge.

literal: Yin happened to reach Kan's post just as the imperial carriage lost its place; at night they came to the river.
idiomatic: Yin happened to reach Kan's post just as the imperial carriage lost its place; at night they came to the river.

literal: Though Kan received the carriage and escorted it north across the river, in secret he wished to flee south; Yin firmly remonstrated and stopped him.
idiomatic: Though Kan received the carriage and escorted it north across the river, in secret he wished to flee south; Yin firmly remonstrated and stopped him.

literal: They thereupon together escorted the court as far as Jian province.
idiomatic: They thereupon together escorted the court as far as Jian province.

literal: He was made regular attendant gentleman of the Unimpeded Staff.
idiomatic: He was made regular attendant gentleman of the unimpeded staff.

literal: Yin, because worldly troubles were not yet settled, wished to withdraw in seclusion; he therefore pleaded illness and with his friend Hejian Xing Shao, attendant gentleman of the Central Straight, hid on Mount Song.
idiomatic: Yin, because worldly troubles were not yet settled, wished to withdraw in seclusion; he therefore pleaded illness and with his friend Hejian Xing Shao, attendant gentleman of the central straight, hid on Mount Song.

literal: When Emperor Zhuang executed Erzhu Rong, his cousin Kan took part in planning within the curtains.
idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang executed Erzhu Rong, his cousin Kan took part in planning within the curtains.

literal: The court made his father Jin inspector of Bingzhou and grand commissioner of the northern route; Yin followed him to his appointment.
idiomatic: The court made his father Jin inspector of Bingzhou and grand commissioner of the northern route; Yin followed him to his appointment.

literal: There was a Handan man named Yang Kuan who sought to follow in righteous service when Jin went out to his province; Yin asked Jin to take him in.
idiomatic: There was a Handan man named Yang Kuan who sought to follow in righteous service when Jin went out to his province; Yin asked Jin to take him in.

literal: Before long Emperor Xiaozhuang was imprisoned and died; Yin at the time was about to return to the capital, reached Handan on the road, passed Yang Kuan's house, and was seized by Kuan.
idiomatic: Before long Emperor Xiaozhuang was imprisoned and died; Yin at the time was about to return to the capital, reached Handan on the road, passed Yang Kuan's house, and was seized by Kuan.

literal: Reaching Xiang province he saw Inspector Liu Yan; because Yin was of a famous house and lofty virtue, Yan greatly pitied him and handed him to Chief Clerk Murong Baize to detain.
idiomatic: Reaching Xiang province he saw inspector Liu Yan; because Yin was of a famous house and lofty virtue, Yan greatly pitied him and handed him to chief clerk Murong Baize to detain.

literal: He sent squad chief Gong Ronggui to guard and escort him to the capital.
idiomatic: He sent squad chief Gong Ronggui to guard and escort him to the capital.

literal: At Anyang Pavilion Yin said to Ronggui: "My house for generations has been loyal ministers, pouring sincerity into the Wei house; now family is destroyed and state broken—things have come to this.
idiomatic: At Anyang Pavilion Yin said to Ronggui, "My house for generations has been loyal ministers, pouring sincerity into the Wei house; now family is destroyed and state broken—things have come to this.

literal: Though called a captive, what face have I to see our lord and father's mortal foes!
idiomatic: Though called a captive, what face have I to see our lord and father's mortal foes!

literal: If I may hang myself on one cord and send my head away, that will be your kindness.
idiomatic: If I may hang myself on one cord and send my head away, that will be your kindness.

literal: " Ronggui deeply pitied and was moved, and thereupon fled with him together.
idiomatic: " Ronggui deeply pitied and was moved, and thereupon fled with him together.

literal: Yin then threw himself on Gao Ao's brothers.
idiomatic: Yin then threw himself on Gao Ao's brothers.

literal: Having lurked in hiding for several years, when Gao Huan reached Xindu he thereupon presented his card at the camp gate.
idiomatic: Having lurked in hiding for several years, when Gao Huan reached Xindu he thereupon presented his card at the camp gate.

literal: He was at once granted audience, praised the rising fortune, and stated his family's calamity; his words were mournful and strong, tears streamed across his face, and Gao Huan changed countenance for it.
idiomatic: He was at once granted audience, praised the rising fortune, and stated his family's calamity; his words were mournful and strong, tears streamed across his face, and Gao Huan changed countenance for it.

literal: He was immediately appointed gentleman of the mobile staff.
idiomatic: He was immediately appointed gentleman of the mobile staff.

literal: When the great army attacked Ye southward and passed Yang Kuan's village, Kuan knelt before the horse and begged forgiveness.
idiomatic: When the great army attacked Ye southward and passed Yang Kuan's village, Kuan knelt before the horse and begged forgiveness.

literal: Yin said to him: "Men not knowing grace and righteousness is also the ordinary rule; I bear you no hatred—have no distant terror.
idiomatic: Yin said to him, "Men not knowing grace and righteousness is also the ordinary rule; I bear you no hatred—have no distant terror.

literal: " At the time Ye had not yet fallen; Gao Huan ordered Yin to compose the text for a sacrifice to Heaven; when the burning was done the city fell.
idiomatic: " At the time Ye had not yet fallen; Gao Huan ordered Yin to compose the text for a sacrifice to Heaven; when the burning was done the city fell.

literal: Thereupon he was transferred to right aide of the grand mobile staff.
idiomatic: Thereupon he was transferred to right aide of the grand mobile staff.

literal: At that time the hegemonic design was newly begun and military and state affairs were broad; proclamations, orders, and edicts all issued from Yin and Cui Ling-Quan.
idiomatic: At that time the hegemonic design was newly begun and military and state affairs were broad; proclamations, orders, and edicts all issued from Yin and Cui Xian.

literal: Having met family disaster, he took mourning ritual as his own rule; what he ate was only salt and rice, and in grief he wasted until only bone remained.
idiomatic: Having met family disaster, he took mourning ritual as his own rule; what he ate was only salt and rice, and in grief he wasted until only bone remained.

literal: Gao Huan pitied him and constantly comforted him.
idiomatic: Gao Huan pitied him and constantly comforted him.

literal: At the battle of Hanling, Yin each time took the van in the line; colleagues all marveled together and said: "The Yang clan's Confucian—now he has become a warrior; the benevolent must be brave—surely no empty saying."
idiomatic: At the battle of Hanling, Yin each time took the van in the line; colleagues all marveled together and said, "The Yang clan's Confucian—now he has become a warrior; the benevolent must be brave—surely no empty saying."

literal: Before long he memorialized asking to leave office and return for burial.
idiomatic: Before long he memorialized asking to leave office and return for burial.

literal: Within one gate, two men had been posthumously given Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, chancellor, and grand general; three had been Grand Commandant, recorder of the masters of writing, and director of the secretariat; five had been vice directors and masters of writing; more than twenty had been inspectors and grand administrators.
idiomatic: Within one gate, two men had been posthumously given grand preceptor, grand tutor, chancellor, and grand general; three had been grand commandant, recorder of the masters of writing, and director of the secretariat; five had been vice directors and masters of writing; more than twenty had been inspectors and grand administrators.

literal: The glory of posthumous honors—never had there been such in past and present.
idiomatic: The glory of posthumous honors—never had there been such in past and present.

literal: When the coffin set out, auspicious and inauspicious guards and escorts stretched more than twenty li; those attending the burial were nearly ten thousand.
idiomatic: When the coffin set out, auspicious and inauspicious guards and escorts stretched more than twenty li; those attending the burial were nearly ten thousand.

literal: That day was deep winter and bitter cold, wind and snow severe and thick; Yin walked barefoot wailing, and those who saw it were without exception moved to pity.
idiomatic: That day was deep winter and bitter cold, wind and snow severe and thick; Yin walked barefoot wailing, and those who saw it were without exception moved to pity.

literal: Before long he was summoned to Jinyang and still held his former post.
idiomatic: Before long he was summoned to Jinyang and still held his former post.

literal: Yin's cousin Youqing was inspector of Qi province; for blunt words that offended the intent he was put to death.
idiomatic: Yin's cousin Youqing was inspector of Qi province; for blunt words that offended the intent he was put to death.

literal: When Yin heard it he was grieved and afraid; grief and shock brought on illness, and later he took urgent leave to go to the hot springs at Yanmen to treat his illness.
idiomatic: When Yin heard it he was grieved and afraid; grief and shock brought on illness, and later he took urgent leave to go to the hot springs at Yanmen to treat his illness.

literal: Guo Xiu by nature envied his ability and therefore sent a letter threatening him, saying: "The Prince of Qi wishes to send you to the Emperor's place.
idiomatic: Guo Xiu by nature envied his ability and therefore sent a letter threatening him, saying, "The Prince of Qi wishes to send you to the Emperor's place.

literal: " He also urged him to flee.
idiomatic: " He also urged him to flee.

literal: Yin thereupon cast off hat and robes at the water's edge as though drowning himself, changed his name, called himself Liu Shi'an, entered Mount Song, and with the monk Tan Mo and others dwelt in seclusion, his traces cut away.
idiomatic: Yin thereupon cast off hat and robes at the water's edge as though drowning himself, changed his name, called himself Liu Shi'an, entered Mount Song, and with the monk Tan Mo and others dwelt in seclusion, his traces cut away.

literal: He also lurked in Guang province and then went east into Tianheng Island, making lecturing and recitation his livelihood.
idiomatic: He also lurked in Guang province and then went east into Tianheng Island, making lecturing and recitation his livelihood.

literal: Gentlemen of the sea's edge called him Master Liu.
idiomatic: Gentlemen of the sea's edge called him Master Liu.

literal: Grand Administrator Wang Yuanjing secretly aided him.
idiomatic: Grand administrator Wang Yuanjing secretly aided him.

literal: Gao Huan knew Yin was alive, sent Yin's cousin Baoyi with a letter to comfort and instruct him, and still sent Guangzhou inspector Xi Siye to search him out and send him off with ritual.
idiomatic: Gao Huan knew Yin was alive, sent Yin's cousin Baoyi with a letter to comfort and instruct him, and still sent Guangzhou inspector Xi Siye to search him out and send him off with ritual.

literal: Gao Huan was pleased to see him, made him staff officer of the Prince of Taiyuan's establishment, transferred him to chief clerk, again gave him right aide of the grand mobile staff, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Huayin county, promoted him to attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gate, and gave him a concubine's daughter in marriage.
idiomatic: Gao Huan was pleased to see him, made him staff officer of the Prince of Taiyuan's establishment, transferred him to chief clerk, again gave him right aide of the grand mobile staff, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Huayin county, promoted him to attendant gentleman of the yellow gate, and gave him a concubine's daughter in marriage.

literal: He also concurrently served as regular attendant gentleman and was chief envoy on a mission of betrothal to Liang.
idiomatic: He also concurrently served as regular attendant gentleman and was chief envoy on a mission of betrothal to Liang.

literal: Reaching Qiaoqiu garrison, within the prefecture was an old Buddhist temple of Yin's family; he entered the pure hall to bow in worship, saw the image of the Grand Tutor, was moved to grief and wailed, vomited several sheng of blood, and thereupon fell ill and could not travel; he was carried ill back to Ye.
idiomatic: Reaching Qiaoqiu garrison, within the prefecture was an old Buddhist temple of Yin's family; he entered the pure hall to bow in worship, saw the image of the grand tutor, was moved to grief and wailed, vomited several sheng of blood, and thereupon fell ill and could not travel; he was carried ill back to Ye.

literal: After a long while, in his former office he was made concurrently gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel in the masters of writing.
idiomatic: After a long while, in his former office he was made concurrently gentleman of the ministry of personnel in the masters of writing.

literal: At the end of Wuding, for the beauty of his reputation and substance he was promoted over others to director of the ministry of personnel, with concurrent palace attendant and guards general; he attended study and directed selection as before.
idiomatic: At the end of Wuding, for the beauty of his reputation and substance he was promoted over others to director of the ministry of personnel, with concurrent palace attendant and guards general; he attended study and directed selection as before.

literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, in his former office he was made heir apparent junior tutor and separately enfeoffed as Baron of Yangxia county.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao, in his former office he was made heir apparent junior tutor and separately enfeoffed as Baron of Yangxia county.

literal: An edict also ordered him to supervise the Grand Astrologer; he was moved to right vice director of the masters of writing.
idiomatic: An edict also ordered him to supervise the grand astrologer; he was moved to right vice director of the masters of writing.

literal: He married the Princess of Taiyuan, who was Empress Xiaojing of Wei.
idiomatic: He married the Princess of Taiyuan, who was Empress Xiaojing of Wei.

literal: Once a pheasant alighted on his residence; he was again appointed commissioner with the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies and left vice director of the masters of writing, and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Huashan commandery.
idiomatic: Once a pheasant alighted on his residence; he was again appointed commissioner with the same ceremonial as the three excellencies and left vice director of the masters of writing, and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Huashan commandery.

literal: In the ninth year he was moved to director of the masters of writing and again appointed special emissary and general of agile cavalry.
idiomatic: In the ninth year he was moved to director of the masters of writing and again appointed special emissary and general of agile cavalry.

literal: In the tenth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Kaifeng.
idiomatic: In the tenth year he was enfeoffed as Prince of Kaifeng.

literal: When Gao Yang died, among the hundred officials none shed tears; Yin grieved beyond bearing.
idiomatic: When Gao Yang died, among the hundred officials none shed tears; Yin grieved beyond bearing.

literal: Jinan succeeded to the enterprise; his appointment and favor grew still greater; court regulations and state commands were his alone—he extended sincerity and embodied the Way, and for a time there was no dissenting voice.
idiomatic: Jinan succeeded to the enterprise; his appointment and favor grew still greater; court regulations and state commands were his alone—he extended sincerity and embodied the Way, and for a time there was no dissenting voice.

literal: In the second month of the first year of Qianming he was executed by Emperor Xiaozhao; he was then fifty.
idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Qianming he was executed by Emperor Xiaozhao; he was then fifty.

literal: At the end of Tiantong he was posthumously given Director of Works.
idiomatic: At the end of Tiantong he was posthumously given director of works.

literal: Yin was a nobleman's son who early won reputation; his bearing, judgment, and discernment were praised by court and countryside alike.
idiomatic: Yin was a nobleman's son who early won reputation; his bearing, judgment, and discernment were praised by court and countryside alike.

literal: When his house met calamity, only two younger brothers, one younger sister, and several elder brother's granddaughters remained; he reared the orphaned young with kind intent and warm countenance, all beyond the common measure.
idiomatic: When his house met calamity, only two younger brothers, one younger sister, and several elder brother's granddaughters remained; he reared the orphaned young with kind intent and warm countenance, all beyond the common measure.

literal: He valued righteousness and held wealth light; gifts before and after he mostly scattered among kin; more than ten younger cousins and nephews all depended on him for their cooking fires.
idiomatic: He valued righteousness and held wealth light; gifts before and after he mostly scattered among kin; more than ten younger cousins and nephews all depended on him for their cooking fires.

literal: Repeatedly meeting adversity, he braved hardship and danger; a single meal's kindness he repaid heavily; a life-and-death foe he could set aside and not inquire after.
idiomatic: Repeatedly meeting adversity, he braved hardship and danger; a single meal's kindness he repaid heavily; a life-and-death foe he could set aside and not inquire after.

literal: Directing selection for more than twenty years, he promoted human worth and took it as his own charge; yet in taking gentlemen he mostly relied on words and looks, and at times drew slander—people said Yin's employing of men was like a poor man buying melons, taking the big ones.
idiomatic: Directing selection for more than twenty years, he promoted human worth and took it as his own charge; yet in taking gentlemen he mostly relied on words and looks, and at times drew slander—people said Yin's employing of men was like a poor man buying melons, taking the big ones.

literal: When Yin heard it he disdained to heed it.
idiomatic: When Yin heard it he disdained to heed it.

literal: His clever memory and strong retention—half a face once seen, never forgotten.
idiomatic: His clever memory and strong retention—half a face once seen, never forgotten.

literal: Whenever he was summoned and questioned, whether only the surname or only the given name was spoken, there was never a mistake.
idiomatic: Whenever he was summoned and questioned, whether only the surname or only the given name was spoken, there was never a mistake.

literal: Later there was a candidate Lu Manhan who said of himself that he was base and lowly and alone went unrecognized.
idiomatic: Later there was a candidate Lu Manhan who said of himself that he was base and lowly and alone went unrecognized.

literal: Yin said: "You before, in Yuan Zisi's lane, rode a bald-tailed grass donkey; passing me you did not dismount; you screened your face with square-curled bread—how should I not know you?
idiomatic: Yin said, "You before, in Yuan Zisi's lane, rode a bald-tailed grass donkey; passing me you did not dismount; you screened your face with square-curled bread—how should I not know you?

literal: " Manhan was startled and submitted.
idiomatic: " Manhan was startled and submitted.

literal: He also teased him, saying: "The name fixes the substance—Manhan indeed is not empty.
idiomatic: He also teased him, saying, "The name fixes the substance—Manhan indeed is not empty.

literal: " He also had a clerk call out men's names and by mistake called Lu Shishen Shichen; Shichen spoke up himself, and Yin said: "Master Lu, jade lustrous—therefore the jade radical. From nature it is so.
idiomatic: " He also had a clerk call out men's names and by mistake called Lu Shishen Shichen; Shichen spoke up himself, and Yin said, "Master Lu, jade lustrous—therefore the jade radical. From nature it is so.
